name: Underling
source:
Foul-mouthed lackey robots that belonged to Lily and the space pirates.

Many of them can be found inside the spaceship, with each having their own personality. They can do almost everything - from piloting the ship to running a food stall.

[Edited from [url=http://coroblo.com/en/character/mechanic.html]official website[/url]]
